items.subject: Grocery: a price band refused rows it cannot explain - 2026-09-26 (absorbed 09-27, 09-28)
evidence: grocery/out/band-refusals-open.json (main, 08:45 run): 197 open rows, first_seen 2026-09-26 53, 2026-09-27 93, 2026-09-28 51; 0 decided; the type paged every day 2026-09-23 to 2026-09-28

against comparison-2026-09-28 (17:28): 177 of 197 open rows are priced at or above their own store's standing cell for the same commodity (cannot move the board), 3 are cheaper than it (bleach FF 0.0066 < 0.074, breakfast-sausage Fareway 0.5225 < 5.32, pears Walmart 0.124 < 2.4779), 17 have no cell at that store; of today's 51 first-day rows 45 were at or above their cell
7ed369's own row: 'apple-cider-vinegar | Baker's | Bragg Organic Apple Cider Vinegar with the Mother | 0.3119 against reference 0.0546', Baker's cell 0.0546 from another row

check-ad-cycles.ps1 changes after the alert (f2e6f1bd8, 58136b287, 788d3782c, 5ad77211a, 1457d5444) move the deferred post and split the script; none touches the band-refusal page (lines 3255-3262 unchanged in meaning)
items.root_cause: The band audit pages every refused row outside the backlog on its first day, whatever its board effect. A store's cell is its cheapest admitted row, so a refused row at or above that cell can never change the published price whether it is a wrong product (the band did its job) or a real premium price; 90% of the open set is that shape, so every day's catalogue growth paged a list nobody had to act on, and the six rows that could move a cell arrived buried in it.

root_fix.what: A band-refused row outside the backlog pages only when it could move a cell (no standing cell at its store for that commodity, a cell unit that does not match, or a price below the cell), and then once, recorded as paged_on in the open file. A shadowed row still counts, stays in the open set and on the worklist, and pages the first run its cell goes or gets dearer. No board beside the flagged file shadows nothing, so it fails toward paging.
root_fix.exact_change: Get-TcBoardCells (id|store -> per_unit, unit from comparison[].stores[]), Get-TcShadowingCell, Set-TcBandPageState (shadowed_by, paged_on, page); the main flow reads comparison-<date>.json beside flagged-<date>.json, pages on .page, prints SHADOWED lines and shadowed= in the COMPLETE marker, and writes paged_on and shadowed_by per open row. An open row written before this rule (no paged_on field, first seen before today) counts as paged.

prevention.what: the emitter itself: it decided what pages, and it paged rows with no possible board effect
prevention.exact_change: page = open, not shadowed by a cheaper-or-equal standing cell at the row's own store, and never paged before (paged_on)

blast_radius.measured_as: live run, main grocery/out with a scratch -OpenFile copy (main band-refusals-open.json hash unchanged)
blast_radius.risk: a shadowed row that is a hidden cheaper real price cannot exist by construction (it is at or above the cell); a row shadowed today whose cell later disappears pages on that day, fixtured. The page body and subject in check-ad-cycles are unchanged; it counts UNEXPLAINED lines, which are now only the rows that could move a cell.

proof.must_fire_case: Fareway breakfast sausage 0.5225 against its store's cell 5.32 pages; Hy-Vee cat food with no Hy-Vee cat-food cell pages; a cell in 'each' on a 'dozen' commodity shadows nothing and pages; one step past the bar (0.0545 against 0.0546) pages; the shadowed Bragg row pages once the day its cell is gone
proof.clean_twin: the 7ed369 Bragg ACV at Baker's (0.3119 against the 0.0546 cell) is SHADOWED and does not page, and stays in the open set with paged_on empty; exactly at the bar (0.0546) is shadowed; the day after it paged it stays quiet; a pre-rule open row does not re-page
